none: PAS CAM-0821A3: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI ; D/ [DN GRAT]IANVS AVGG AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian. (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Reverse shows Emperor right with shield and standard. Mint is Arles, AD 367-375. See RIC IX, no.15. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [DN GRAT]IANVS AVGG AVG. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.01g, diameter is 17.77mm
